summary: Vision Marine Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting the completed sale of its Fort Lauderdale property at 1440 S. Federal Highway, closed July 31, 2026, under its Florida real estate optimization plan. The property was acquired in the June 2025 Nautical Ventures acquisition; proceeds were applied per closing mechanics. The sale simplifies its footprint, with operations moved to Dania Beach and Fort Lauderdale Marina. Also announced a TSX Venture Exchange-approved normal course issuer bid for up to 326,523 shares (5% outstanding) with Ventum Financial. Watch for liquidity deployment and operational efficiency.
